BytePlus Growth Analysis is a one\-stop user analysis and operation platform that provides enterprises with digital consumer behavior analysis insights, optimizes digital touchpoint user experience, supports refined user operation, discovers key growth points of business, and improves enterprise efficiency.

We can divide users in the enterprise into three categories: **data analyst**, **data developer**, and **platform manager** . Each type of role has different concerns and goals in the process of learning and using. We will share with you in this article the learning paths and rich learning resources for different types of users, so that you can learn according to your role and ensure that you can systematically master the core functions and application skills of the product.

<span id="ea583a56"></span>
# Learning Resource Preparation: Request a Free Trial

DataFinder provides a free trial version for all new users. New users can apply for a free trial for 30 days. The free trial version is the **SaaS\-cloud native version**, which can use 20,000 MTU for free.

If you have never purchased DataFinder, you can register on the BytePlus official website and log in to the [DataFinder product homepage ](https://www.byteplus.com/en/product/datafinder)to apply for a free trial, see details [Free Trial for New Users](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Free_Trial_for_New_Users).

<span id="00b83d48"></span>
# Product use general process

Before learning the course of DataFinder systematically, you can first understand the general usage process of DataFinder.

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

The following courses are organized around three core roles and common usage processes.

<span id="e10dc936"></span>
# Learning Path: Fundamentals (Required for all roles)

Before each role uses the product, learn the following to understand the fundamentals of the DataFinder product.


* Product environment distinction: [SaaS Cloud-Native & Privatized Environments](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/SaaS_Cloud-Native_Privatized_Environments).

* Some basic concepts of DataFinder: [Explanation of DataFinder Proper Nouns](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Explanation_of_DataFinder_Proper_Nouns), [Data Model](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Data_Model), [Event Tracking, Full Event Tracking](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Event_Tracking_Full_Event_Tracking),[User ID (uid, ssid, did)](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/User_ID_uid_ssid_did).
